cc:Work.dc:title: KD mutex storage and registry comparison
cc:Work.dc:description: Input comparison.json SHA256: 5a105efe65375bb0ba14a9836fea418619849d8e3a0fe415e0960e50215df345. 96/96 eligible plain sessions; three planned repeats per version/workload/worker group. Median whole-interval Mops/s with observed min-max ranges, not confidence intervals. Source versions ran sequentially, not randomized. Profile sessions are excluded. Mixed execution classes have no pooled point; lines stop at execution-class changes or missing data.
